古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是跟他开玩笑。孟子妈妈看到他的同学们对孟子有不好的影响，所以搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要” / Formula: 在 + historical time period，+ people + thought / Correct: “在古代，人们觉得祭拜非常重要。” “在古代” is more natural than “古代的时候,” and “人们” is needed to mean “people” generally.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions, and generic people should be 人们 rather than 人.
